content.text: You're an ebook author in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, and you're blocked from using Stripe for your ebook sales. You're not alone. Every day, thousands of creators face the same restriction due to arbitrary country or platform restrictions. The costs add up, and the fees eat into your profit margin. Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-4|difference]] retains $921. This is where your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-fonts-online-without-paypal-explained-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal|The Full]] sovereignty begins, with a payment and delivery pipeline that is yours to control and own.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

This infrastructure works because it's built on free and paid tools that give you full control over your payment and delivery pipeline. You don't rely on a single platform or payment processor, eliminating the risk of arbitrary restrictions or high fees. With GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Cloudflare Workers, you have a flexible and scalable platform for hosting and processing your ebook sales. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly, handling automatic crypto payment processing and instant delivery of your ebooks.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy this infrastructure, you need to have your ebook ready for sale. This includes creating a product page, adding a buy button, and configuring your payment and delivery settings. You'll also need to set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your infrastructure. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and a NOWPayments integration guide to get you started.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your infrastructure. This involves adding a payment button to your product page, configuring your payment settings, and setting up automatic delivery of your ebooks. With Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery process, ensuring that your customers receive their ebooks instantly after payment confirmation.
Automating ebook delivery with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script reduces the risk of manual errors and increases customer satisfaction.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live and process your first transaction, you'll need to test your infrastructure thoroughly. This involves testing your payment button, payment settings, and ebook delivery process. With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the testing process, ensuring that your infrastructure is ready for production. Once you're live, you can start processing transactions and delivering your ebooks to customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

To scale your infrastructure once it's running, you'll need to monitor your traffic and adjust your settings accordingly. This involves adding more workers or scripts to handle increased traffic, configuring your caching settings, and optimizing your delivery process. With the Sovereign Blueprint ($47), you'll have access to a scaling playbook and a NOWPayments integration guide to help you scale your infrastructure efficiently.
How do you accept Bitcoin as a payment?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.

You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more products and solutions that help you achieve infrastructure sovereignty. For more information on NOWPayments and its features, visit the NOWPayments website.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this infrastructure, follow these steps: Create a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your infrastructure. Add a payment button to your product page and configure your payment settings. Set up automatic delivery of your ebooks with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Test your infrastructure thoroughly to ensure that it's ready for production. Monitor your traffic and adjust your settings accordingly to scale your infrastructure efficiently. Use The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) to get started with complete documentation and a NOWPayments integration guide.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the recommended network for low fees?

The recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON, which offer transaction fees under $0.10. With NOWPayments, you can automatically select the best network for your transactions based on fees.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my infrastructure?

To integrate NOWPayments with your infrastructure, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and add a payment button to your product page. Configure your payment settings and set up automatic delivery of your ebooks with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides a NOWPayments integration guide to help you get started.
What is the process for automating ebook delivery?

To automate ebook delivery, you'll need to set up a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script that delivers your ebooks instantly after payment confirmation. This involves configuring your delivery settings, adding a buy button to your product page, and integrating NOWPayments with your infrastructure.
What is the cost of using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script?

Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script offer free plans, making them a cost-effective option for automating ebook delivery. With a free plan, you can handle a large volume of transactions without incurring additional costs.
Can I use this infrastructure for other digital products?

Yes, you can use this infrastructure for other digital products, including courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation for all 5 stacks, making it easy to adapt this infrastructure to your specific needs.
How do I troubleshoot issues with my infrastructure?

To troubleshoot issues with your infrastructure, start by checking your payment settings, ebook delivery settings, and NOWPayments integration. Use the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for troubleshooting guides and NOWPayments integration support.
